input.body:
## Summary

```text
UpgradeMenu service
  one capture → 19 saved blur frames → source-over reversal
  retained clock across creator/viewer visits
  card click → place avatar immediately → fade → finish menu
  creator return → existing slot: Destroy / empty slot: SecondSetup
```

Layer 4 of the five-PR batch, based on #127. Replaces CSS blur and immediate card dismissal with the source bitmap history, signed foreground alpha and separate card/bottom listener phases. World retains no browser image objects.

## Evidence

- **Before:** selecting a card closed the menu immediately; creator visits discarded its presentation.
  **After:** replacement is synchronous, card/Edit handlers stop during reversal, the hovered frame is retained, and existing bottom handlers remain available. Full opening closes on the source's 41st closing Run.
- Formatting, TypeScript and 852 unit tests / 7,944 assertions passed; 15 focused timing/service tests cover reversal, retained children, bitmap disposal and shared secondary-help return mode.
- Six affected browser cases passed in mock/supplied-file modes without skips. The final two presentation cases passed again after hover/disabled-opacity fixes. Production builds passed; screenshots inspected.
- Browser tests verify one retained capture across creator/viewer visits, immediate health-label replacement and a still-visible fading menu. Restored progression is an explicit fixture.
- Layer 5 still owns fresh interface-frame capture preparation, newly registered stage-listener cohorts, Main/world/art scheduling and the background latch. Whole-game/original/Adobe parity remains unproved.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** upgrade

Changes menu lifetime, bitmap painting, input timing and creator return routes. Hold master until all five layers and the final assembled head pass current-head Actions/review gates. Intermediate `stack/**` Vercel previews remain deliberately disabled.
